entry.content:

entry.title: [ERI1C][Backup as a Service] - Rack ERI0111E01A - Veeam Backup Managed incident notification
entry.content:
Nov 17, 00:38 UTC
Resolved - We would like to inform you that the incident affecting our Backup as a Service offering has now been resolved.

Please find the details of this incident below :

Start time : 16/11/2026 23:07 UTC
End time : 17/11/2026 00:36 UTC
Impacted Service(s) : Some Veeam Backup Managed storage servers were temporarily unavailable in the ERI1 region.
Customers Impact : Some customers may have experienced issues running or restoring their VM backups.
Root Cause : This incident was caused by a cooling system issue.

We thank you for your understanding and patience throughout this incident.

Nov 16, 23:25 UTC
Identified - We are currently experiencing an incident affecting our Backup as a Service offering in the rack ERI0111E01A in ERI1. The root cause has been identified.

Please find the details of this incident below :

Start time : 16/11/2026 23:07 UTC
Impacted Service(s) : Some Veeam Backup Managed storage servers are temporarily unavailable in the specified rack.
Customers Impact : Some customers are temporarily unable to run or restore their VM backups.
Root Cause : This incident is caused by a cooling system issue.
Ongoing Actions : Our teams are actively working to restore service as quickly as possible.

We will keep you updated on the progress and resolution.
We apologize for any inconvenience caused and appreciate your understanding.
